description: Source code for an Android Wear watch face service implementing an analog watch face with a sweep second hand, including styling, drawing, and system interaction logic.

classes.name: SweepWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, providing the engine for the watch face.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling drawing, system events, and state management for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style, paints, loads background images, and sets up color palette extraction.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in device properties like low-bit ambient mode and burn-in protection.

methods.name: updateWatchHandStyle
methods.description: Updates paint styles based on ambient mode.

methods.name: onInterruptionFilterChanged
methods.description: Adjusts display brightness and transparency in mute mode.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface size changes, scaling background images, and preparing gray background for ambient mode.

methods.name: initGrayBackgroundBitmap
methods.description: Creates a grayscale version of the background image for ambient mode.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the watch face, including background, tick marks, and clock hands, updating every frame when visible.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters system receivers based on visibility.

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the bounds for the peek card overlay.

methods.name: registerReceiver
methods.description: Registers for system time zone change broadcasts.
